bio: Research Overview Contact Us Yannik received his PhD in Pharmacology from the University of Sherbrooke in Quebec, Canada in 2011. He joined the lab in October 2010 and is currently characterizing the role of a new regulator of Rspondin/b-catenin signaling and self-renewal of intestinal epithelial stem cells.
